project_metadata.name: Chatbot-Readable Editorial Resume & Interactive Portfolio
project_metadata.target_framework: React (CRA) + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion + Lenis
project_metadata.theme_mode: Dual (Default Light Warm Paper `#FBF9F5` with Dark Charcoal Obsidian `#0D0E10` Toggle)
project_metadata.file_type_notice: JavaScript files (.js / .jsx) used in this repository

design_principles.fusion: Swiss poster typographic grid meets high-fashion editorial layout and AI-crawler machine readability
design_principles.emotion: Intellectual rigor, architectural precision, tactile paper texture, effortless transparency
design_principles.content_storytelling: Every section is an editorial column with metadata callouts, line reveals, and machine-first structured data
design_principles.negative_space: Generous vertical gaps (py-24 to py-36), deliberate asymmetric borders, zero clutter
design_principles.contrast: Stark contrast ink against warm paper tone, 1px geometric grid rules, single vivid crimson accent

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-[1.05]
hierarchy.subtitle: text-base sm:text-lg text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400 font-sans leading-relaxed
hierarchy.meta_mono: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-neutral-500 dark:text-neutral-400

key_features_and_bot_readability.semantic_html: Semantic tags (<header>, <main>, <article>, <section>, <aside>, <footer>) enriched with microdata and aria-labels for LLM scapes.
key_features_and_bot_readability.json_ld_schema: Embedded <script type="application/ld+json"> containing Person, JobPosting, ProfilePage, and ContactPoint schema.
key_features_and_bot_readability.llms_txt_exporter: Accessible raw route & downloadable file at `/llms.txt` and modal view containing full markdown prompt-engineered resume.
key_features_and_bot_readability.resume_json: Standardized JSON Resume schema format available at `/resume.json` and via download link.
key_features_and_bot_readability.plain_text_download: Direct button to download `.txt` version optimized for ATS and AI crawlers.

ask_my_resume_chat.type: Interactive client-side floating drawer / modal widget
ask_my_resume_chat.engine: Keyword & Intent matching engine (fast, zero external API key needed, natural typing animation)
suggested_questions: What is Alex's background in full-stack architecture?
What AI and Machine Learning tools does Alex specialize in?
Where has Alex worked and what were key impact metrics?
How can I contact Alex for a lead role?
ask_my_resume_chat.data_source: Structured resume knowledge graph with multi-keyword fallback

layout_sections.description: Sticky minimal header with Lenis smooth jump links, theme toggle, Monogram logo, and AI Crawler Links dropdown
Kinetic typography reveal, masked line-by-line load animation, 3D Monogram interactive tilt canvas, status indicator ('Available for Staff/Lead roles'), and quick actions
High-visibility technical bar spotlighting LLM readiness: links to llms.txt, resume.json, raw txt, and schema modal
Slow drifting text ribbon with low contrast typography & dot separators highlight core competencies
Two-column editorial split with portrait, philosophy statement, quick stat counters, and core principles
Interactive chronological timeline with expandable detail panels, tech stack tags, and quantifiable achievements
Bento grid matrix categorizing System Architecture, Modern Frontend, Backend/Cloud, and AI Systems with proficiency bars
Editorial project showcases with preview cards, key metrics, GitHub repo links, live demo links, and tech pills
Degrees, certifications, publications, and continuous learning log in Swiss grid style
Clean contact hub featuring Email, LinkedIn, GitHub, and message copy helper. STRICTLY NO phone number or residential address.
Floating action button triggering an AI-styled 'Ask My Resume' chat assistant with instant answers and suggestions

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Lenis smooth scroll initializes on mount and handles hash links smoothly.
Provide modal/viewers for llms.txt, resume.json, and structured JSON-LD preview so reviewers can immediately test machine readability.
Implement the Ask My Resume floating widget with responsive mobile sheet support, typing indicator effect, and preset quick-click questions.
Keep privacy strict: Email (alex.vance.dev@gmail.com), LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/alexvance-dev), and GitHub (github.com/alexvance-dev). DO NOT add phone number or physical address anywhere.
Make sure all interactive elements carry data-testid attributes for E2E automated testing.
Add fallback plain content visible even if JavaScript animations are slow or prefers-reduced-motion is active.
